note: AI-simulated students, written to show how the Workshop works: their pages, their variables for one bank chart, and the report the two make together. Every figure, year and name is checked against the chart by the same rules the app uses on your casts, and every report passes the Ten Wards with no red rows, except one: Ploy's A2 reports are 120–145 words, under the 150 the exam needs, so her length row stays red (Task Achievement is capped at 5). The band estimates are an AI reviewer's reading of the public descriptors, not official IELTS scores.
